note: the distance transform runs the column pass only and skips the row pass, so a pixel beside a lone shape pixel reads as infinitely far, caught by DistanceFieldTests.exactEuclidean
anchor: envelopePass(&f, &nearest, lines: height, length: width, along: 1, across: width, border: border, &scratch)

note: the distance field level test is strict, so a pixel whose alpha equals the level is left out of the shape, caught by DistanceFieldTests.levelIsInclusive
the stroke swaps outside and inside of the shape, so an outside stroke paints over the layer instead of around it, caught by AlphaEffectTests.outsideStrokeIsOutside and insideStrokeIsInside
the inside field drops the transparent ring past the buffer's edge, so a fully opaque buffer reads as infinitely deep, caught by DistanceFieldTests.insideCountsBorderRing
anchor: insideField = Self.transform(seeds: shape.map { !$0 }, width: width, height: height, border: true).distance
replacement: insideField = Self.transform(seeds: shape.map { !$0 }, width: width, height: height, border: false).distance

note: the stroke coverage is a hard step instead of a one-pixel smoothstep ramp, so the stroke's far edge is aliased, caught by AlphaEffectTests.outsideStrokeIsOutside and strokeMeasuresAntiAliasedEdge
